name.title: Channel name
name.description: Specify a unique name for the public or private channel. The channel name must be 80 characters or less and only contain lowercase letters, numbers, hyphens, and underscores.

is_channel.title: Is channel
is_channel.description: Indicates whether it is a channel

created.title: Created date
created.description: A Unix timestamp of when the channel was created

creator.title: Creator
creator.description: The user ID of the member who created the channel

is_archived.title: Is archived
is_archived.description: Indicates whether the channel is archived

is_general.title: Is general
is_general.description: Indicates whether the channel is general

is_member.title: Is member
is_member.description: Indicates whether the calling member is a part of the channel

last_read.title: Last read
last_read.description: The date the channel was last read in ISO 8601 UTC format, YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SSZ

latest.title: Latest
latest.description: The information about the latest item on the channel

user.title: User
user.description: The user who created the latest item. For example, the most recent user who created a file or message in the channel.

old_name.title: Old name
old_name.description: The older name of the channel

name.title: Name
name.description: The new name of the channel

type.title: Type
type.description: The type of the latest item. For example, the most recent type of item, such as a file or message, in the channel.

subtype.title: Subtype
subtype.description: The sub-type of the latest item. For example, the most recent sub-type of item, such as a file or message, in the channel.

text.title: Text
text.description: The text of the latest item. For example, the most recent text of an item, such as a file or message, in the channel

ts.title: Timestamp
ts.description: The latest date of a message posted on the channel

unread_count.title: Unread count
unread_count.description: The number of items marked as unread. The total number of messages that the user has yet to read.

unread_count_display.title: Unread count display
unread_count_display.description: The number of items marked as unread. The total number of messages that the user has yet to read.

members.title: Members
members.description: The users that belong to a particular channel

value.title: Value
value.description: The name of the current topic

creator.title: Creator
creator.description: The user identifier that created the channel

last_set.title: Last set
last_set.description: The date of the last set topic in ISO 8601 UTC format, YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SSZ

creator.title: Creator
creator.description: The user ID that created the current purpose

last_set.title: Last set
last_set.description: The date of the last set purpose in ISO 8601 UTC format, YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SSZ

num_members.title: Number of members
num_members.description: The total number of members in a channel

is_starred.title: Is starred
is_starred.description: Indicates whether the channel is starred

previous_names.title: Previous names
previous_names.description: The previous names of the channel
